name: Elliptical
steps: Hold the stationary rails to step onto the elliptical, center your feet on the pedals and grasp the moving handles.
Stand tall with your chest lifted, core lightly braced, and shoulders relaxed.
Drive smoothly through your feet in a continuous gliding stride while pushing and pulling the handles in sync with your alternating legs.
Maintain an even cadence and resistance for the duration or target distance, then slow down gradually before stepping off.
tips: Avoid leaning heavily onto the console or rails, which reduces lower-body engagement.
Keep your heels mostly flat on the pedals instead of pushing solely off your toes.
